name: Stage II: Align 3DGS with Radiance Field
definition: A second stage that finetunes Gaussian configuration to minimize discrepancy between deformed 3DGS rendering and the deformed radiance field, defined by radial features F and O.
summary: Stage II finetunes Gaussian parameters to align deformed 3DGS with a ground-truth radiance field, distinguishing itself by matching field-wise features rather than just pixel colors.
